description:
The closure's runtime_demands map is dead: every production reader was re-pointed onto the per-executable RuntimeDemand(E) fact (read via world.runtime_demand(exec)). Spike re-pointed collect_transport_contexts (transport.rs:726,871) and MaterializeRoot (artifact.rs:131); the semantic_analysis_test that asserts per-executable RuntimeDemand(E) answers the same questions as closure.runtime_demands still passes -> the payload is provably redundant.

DO: delete the field SemanticClosure.runtime_demands (semantic.rs:501); drop the seal's gather loop that reads RuntimeDemand(E) for every executable purely to assemble it (root.rs:302-318) — KEEP only the latent-discovery read that demanded_callable_executables still needs (that read moves/dies in seal.4, not here); retarget runtime_demand.defined per-root telemetry (world.rs:1137-1198) to iterate closure.executables + world.runtime_demand(exec); migrate the 5 transport_contract_test/semantic_analysis_test readers of closure.runtime_demands to per-executable facts.

REMOVES: the closure's demand payload and the seal's RuntimeDemand(E) VALUE subscription for the payload. PROVEN safe (spike Move B, lib 934/0, still Resolved + 3 closure changes). One commit.
title: Delete SemanticClosure.runtime_demands payload
